import runpy,signal,json,time
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/Users/johnroehm/Programming/PythonEnvironments/Physics/Fluid-Based-Physics-Research/.publication-l1-checkpoint-20261103/docs/audits/2026-10-17-publication-substance-construction/l1_extended_offset_witness_k4_two_protected_tori.py')
def deadline(*args):raise TimeoutError('scientific phase deadline')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,deadline);signal.alarm(600);start=time.monotonic();s=runpy.run_path(str(p));row,g=s['data']()[243]
branches=list(s['branches'](g));assert len(branches)==225
prepared=[(weight,s['prepare'](g,core)) for weight,core in branches];assert all(item is not None for weight,item in prepared)
prep=time.monotonic()-start;signal.alarm(60);t=time.monotonic();value=s['Fraction']();peak=0
for weight,(factors,divisor,exclusive) in prepared:
 raw,size=s['k3'].eliminate_components(factors,exclusive);value+=weight*s['Fraction'](raw,divisor);peak=max(peak,size)
warm=time.monotonic()-t;signal.alarm(0)
raw=value*g.divisor;assert raw.denominator==1
print(json.dumps({'word':243,'coefficient':[value.numerator,value.denominator],'divisor':g.divisor,'raw_numerator':raw.numerator,'branches':225,'execution':'canonical prepare plus complete225 canonical eliminate_components weighted sum; prepared factor tables reused once','fixed_sources':sorted(g.fixed_sources),'sources':g.sources,'action_edges':len(g.edges),'peak_rows':peak,'preparation_seconds':prep,'warm_seconds':warm,'full_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'preparation_limit_seconds':600,'warm_limit_seconds':60,'source_sha256':s['source_hashes']()}),flush=True)
